first violation: energy 23888 exceeds allowed 1974 at step 7
heavy body velocity explodes from 0 to ~51 m/s after collision

counterfactual.change: Reduced body 1 initial vx from -47.877 to -5.0 (single field change: bodies[1].vx) to lower impact speed/mass-ratio impulse magnitude; eliminates energy injection.

explanation: Between step 6 and 7 the light body (m=1, vx≈-47.87) collides with heavy stationary body (m≈16.94). Correct elastic collision should approximately conserve momentum/energy, but energy jumps from ~1790J to 23888J (>13x) with both bodies acquiring ~45-51 m/s after contact. Substeps_in_step rises to 24 indicating aggressive sub-stepping for fast body. Likely impulse/positional-correction loop diverges for high mass ratio + high impact speed + e≈0.3/0.8, injecting kinetic energy instead of conserving it. Reducing impact speed from 47.9 to 5.0 removes energy violation.
vision_note: Steps 4-6 show two blue bodies slowly closing distance; at step 7 the smaller right body contacts the larger left body and they visibly overlap/interpenetrate instead of cleanly separating.
